# BoloSign

> BoloSign is an electronic signature platform for small and growing businesses. Teams use it to send PDFs, reusable templates and forms for legally binding e-signatures, with flat plan pricing instead of per-user or per-envelope fees.

- Company: BoloSign is made by BoloForms (Closer Innovation Labs Corp.). Some review sites list it as "BoloForms Signature".
- Web app: https://signature.boloforms.com
- Plans, billed annually: Free; Freelancer $10/month (100 form submissions and 10 PDFs per month); Team $49/month (500 form submissions per month, unlimited members, PDFs and templates under a fair-use policy); Growing Business $99/month (unlimited form submissions under a fair-use policy, 2 workspaces); Enterprise with custom pricing (SSO, approval workflows, CRM integrations, DocuSign import). Billed monthly: Freelancer $15, Team $69, Growing Business $129. Paid plans include a 7-day free trial with no credit card required. Current prices and limits: https://www.boloforms.com/signature/pricing/
- Add-ons: HIPAA business associate agreement $49/month; SMS sending at $12 for 500 credits.
- API: $40/month for 100 documents, $72/month for 200 documents, $180/month for 500 documents, $360/month for 1000 documents, $720/month for 2000 documents; $0.50 for each document beyond the plan; custom pricing from 3,000 documents a month. Sandbox testing with 20 documents is free. Details: https://www.boloforms.com/signature/api/
- Compliance stated by BoloSign: ESIGN Act, UETA, eIDAS, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA (with the BAA add-on), SOC 2 Type I and Type II, ISO 27001:2022.
- Rating: 4.6/5 on Capterra, as of 2026-11-15 (https://www.capterra.com/p/10019315/BoloForms-Signature/).
- Support: support@boloforms.com · Help center: https://help.boloforms.com/en/
